results.name: SAVE STATUS: saved only after the write; a failing write says NOT SAVED, survives a reload, then saves
LOAD ERROR: a library that cannot be read shows an error, never an empty library
results.detail: error shown, retry loads the projects

results.name: RECOVERY POINTS: restore an earlier point, the current state is saved first and can be restored too
LOST LIBRARY: the main database is wiped, projects come back from recovery points
BACKUP FILE: not counted until checked; a damaged file is refused; restore never replaces newer progress
results.detail: verified only after checking; newer progress kept

results.name: RE-READ with progress: same instructions are re-read after a recovery point; changed instructions are refused
results.detail: refused when unsafe, safe re-read keeps the place

results.name: OFFLINE: knitting with no network is saved on the phone and survives a reload
